comment: Frozen generation battery for the composite decay scalar (SYNTHESIS section 4). Authored 2026-08-29, before the probe-2 noise sweep. Never edit after the sweep starts. 120 generic chat/instruction prompts feed R/D/J; 40 difficulty-tiered factual items (with short reference answers) additionally feed F.
